polish.details: Professional naturalist-family finish. Hover states and reduced-motion counterparts exist for every transition, SVG icons are generated (generate_sh_icons.mjs --check: no drift), the puck uses pre-rendered sprites, and canvas text repaints after document.fonts.load (index.html:2596-2598). No placeholder copy. A headless sweep of en/fr/zh-Hans x 8 lesson captions at 1180x780 found no new clipped or ellipsised text beyond the known encReadN carry. Minor: some canvas ruler labels are low-contrast (UI-004).

consistency.details: All 8 knobs share one binder (same drag travel, Shift-fine mode, wheel gesture, dblclick reset, detent on bipolar knobs). Segmented controls share paint/aria code. Outliers: French copy uses a decimal comma ('0,2 m') but every numeric readout prints a point (UI-006). Knob pointerdown accepts any mouse button, while the sphere drags filter to button 0 (UI-007).

accessibility.details: Every control has a localized aria-label (data-i18n-aria) and :focus-visible outlines (index.html:240-664). Segments use radiogroup/radio with aria-checked. html lang follows the selector. DOM text clears AA (text-muted 5.11:1 on paper, active lesson 4.9:1). Gaps: role=slider has no aria-valuemin/max/now and only arrow keys work (UI-005). Canvas labels are drawn at 0.45-0.6 alpha (3.0-4.3:1, which the gates cannot see; UI-004). Many 9.5-10 px labels drop to about 6 px at the 0.6x minimum scale (UI-008).

responsiveness.details: Fixed-aspect 0.6x-1.5x resize, a persisted scale clamped to the current display, CSS transform scaling, and uiScale folded into the canvas backing store. The tooltip sits outside the transformed #plugin, and the measure-then-pin clamp is correct. Gap: a devicePixelRatio change without a window resize does not re-run the canvas resize (UI-003).

threadSafety.details: Member order is correct: 12 relays (PluginEditor.h:127-138), then webView (141), then 12 attachments (144-155), so attachments are destroyed first. All 12 relays are registered with withOptionsFrom (PluginEditor.cpp:168-179). IDs come from the frozen ParamIDs. Attachment types match the parameter types (Slider for 8 floats, ComboBox for 3 choices, Toggle for 1 bool). The audio path uses only cached getRawParameterValue atomics. The Timer is message-thread only, the TripleBuffer is read by one consumer, and stopTimer is called in the destructor (cpp:335). Open gestures are closed in the destructor. The payload is formatted locale-free into a bounded member buffer. Attachments are assigned in the constructor body, not the initializer list (needed because they must follow webView construction; acceptable).

webviewIntegrity.details: macOS integrity is good. The resource provider uses bare-path matching and has a branch for all 10 juce_add_binary_data files (cpp:103-135; fonts land at /fonts/ for the ../fonts/ url). The Juce namespace is imported and passed. All 5 natives the page calls are registered (getParameterDefaults, getUiLanguage, setUiLanguage, uiReady, applyFactoryPreset), so no promise is left hanging. The uiReady handshake runs after the listener exists. Readouts use getScaledValue, and the distance/orbitRate ranges use setSkewForCentre rather than a lambda, so the JS skew matches. BLOCKER: the Windows options never select the WebView2 backend (UI-001), so the editor is a 'page not found' page on every Windows host.

issues.description: The #if JUCE_WINDOWS block sets withWinWebView2Options(withUserDataFolder(...)) but never calls .withBackend(juce::WebBrowserComponent::Options::Backend::webview2). On Windows, Backend::defaultBackend is the legacy IE control. It ignores withWinWebView2Options and has no resource provider, so goToURL(getResourceProviderRoot()) at cpp:291 shows 'page not found' and the whole UI is dead on every Windows DAW. This is the same defect fixed in O-simpleSubtractive v1.7.1 (8a83d78f) and in 9 plugins in b477dc83. O-simpleAmbisonics is named in that census (memory critical_webview2_runtime_gotchas_windows) but was not included in the sweep. `grep -n withBackend Source/*.cpp` returns nothing at HEAD. Every macOS gate (auval, pluginval, ui-stub probes) passes regardless.
issues.fixSuggestion: Chain .withBackend(juce::WebBrowserComponent::Options::Backend::webview2) onto options inside the JUCE_WINDOWS block before withWinWebView2Options, mirroring O-simpleSubtractive PluginEditor.cpp:192-200. Keep the temp-dir user-data folder. Then confirm on a Windows build that the page loads.

issues.description: The language is a one-shot pull. The page calls getUiLanguage once at init, while setStateInformation can later overwrite uiLanguage (and editorScale) while the editor is open. Example: a host loads a session or preset chunk saved in French into an open English editor. The atomic changes, the page stays English, and the next getStateInformation writes the restored 'fr' back. The page and the saved state then disagree until the editor is reopened (pattern_webview_one_shot_state_push_stale_on_preset_load). Low impact because language is not a parameter.
issues.fixSuggestion: Bump a counter in setStateInformation. Have the editor timer compare it and emit a 'uiLanguage' event the page applies with applyI18n. Alternatively, document the reopen-to-apply behaviour as intentional.

issues.description: Canvas backing stores are resized only from applyUiScale, which listens to window 'resize'. Dragging the plugin window from a Retina display to a 1x display (or back) changes devicePixelRatio without a resize event. All five canvases then keep the old backing size: blurry on 2x, wasted fill rate on 1x. The puck sprite cache keys on DPR, but it is only consulted on redraw and the canvas itself is not resized.
issues.fixSuggestion: Add a matchMedia('(resolution: <dpr>dppx)') change listener, re-armed after each change, that calls applyUiScale. This is the standard DPR-change idiom.

issues.description: Canvas text is drawn in parchment at low alpha on the #2a2118 well. The distance ring labels ('0.5 m'...'20 m') use 0.45 alpha, about 3.0:1. The output meter dB ruler uses 0.6 alpha at 9.5 px, about 4.3:1. Both are below AA 4.5:1 for small text. The DOM contrast gates cannot see canvas pixels (canvas AA is gate-blind).
issues.fixSuggestion: Raise the alpha of these ruler labels to at least 0.75 (about 5.5:1), or draw them in the --ink-parch solid. Keep the ring strokes faint; only the text needs more contrast.

issues.description: Knobs set role=slider and aria-valuetext but never aria-valuemin, aria-valuemax or aria-valuenow, so assistive tech reports an incomplete slider. The keydown handler handles only the arrow keys. Home/End (min/max) and PageUp/PageDown (coarse step), which ARIA expects for a slider, do nothing.
issues.fixSuggestion: In bindKnob, set aria-valuemin=0, aria-valuemax=1 and update aria-valuenow with the normalised value in updateKnobVisual. Add Home/End to set 0 or 1, and PageUp/PageDown for a 10-step nudge, each wrapped in sliderDragStarted/Ended like nudge().

issues.description: The French lesson captions use a decimal comma ('Essayez 0,2 m'), but every numeric readout and every composed var (FORMAT.distance, orbitRate, dB, kHz) prints a decimal point in all languages. A French user sees '0,2 m' in the footer caption and '0.20 m' under the Distance knob at the same moment. Also, all 150 French entries in i18n.js are still reviewed:false, so Stage 4 owes a French review pass.
issues.fixSuggestion: Pick one convention for fr. Either keep points everywhere and change the caption to '0.2 m', or route FORMAT and the composed vars through a uiLanguage-aware decimal separator. Settle it during the French review of the 150 unreviewed entries.

issues.description: Knob pointerdown has no e.button check, unlike the sphere drags (index.html:2387: if (e.button !== 0) return). A right-click or middle-click on a knob opens a host automation gesture (sliderDragStarted), and any vertical jitter before release writes values. Since the context menu is suppressed globally, a right-click that looks like a no-op can still leave a touched-parameter automation point in Logic or Cubase.
issues.fixSuggestion: Return early from the knob pointerdown handler when e.button !== 0, matching bindSphereDrags.

issues.description: Many captions are authored at 9.5-10 px (chip heads, band-ch, chan-scale, enc order tags, station subs, seg caps). The page scales by CSS transform down to minScale 0.6, where these render at about 5.7-6 px. They stay legible at 1.0x, but they are below the 12 px guideline at the scales a small laptop's fit-to-display picks (fitScaleForDisplay can choose 0.6-0.9).
issues.fixSuggestion: Consider raising minScale to about 0.75, or bumping the 9.5 px tier to 10.5 px, so that the smallest text never renders below about 7.5 px. This is a design decision; flagged for awareness.

issues.description: The lesson button 'active' highlight and the footer caption persist after the user moves any parameter away from the lesson state. They are also not restored on editor reopen, so the page can claim 'Behind You' is active while the source sits in front. The kLessons table is being replaced this stage, so this is low priority.
issues.fixSuggestion: When the shared recipe table and preset manager land, clear .active and restore label.tourDefault on the first user-originated parameter change after a lesson (valueChanged outside the apply window), or derive 'active' from a C++ current-preset field.
